model_syntax:
# =======================================
  # Reflective Measurement Model
  # =======================================

  Symbolism =~ symb_envresp + symb_modern
  AoC =~ aoc_transport + aoc_overstated + aoc_minor
  BEnv =~ ben_env_reduce + ben_env_shift + ben_env_nodiff

  Reactance =~ reactance_interfere + reactance_rulesharm + reactance_commongood + reactance_individual
  AntiIntel =~ antiintel_commonsense + antiintel_facts + antiintel_expertshelp


  power =~ bev_better_towing +
           bev_better_accel +
           bev_better_power

  non_power =~ bev_better_comfort +
                 bev_better_safety +
                 bev_better_reliability +
                 bev_better_roughroad
                 
  range =~ range_prosp_routine +  range_prosp_longtrip + range_prosp_cold + range_prosp_hills 
  compatibility =~ fit_hh_prosp_fit + fit_hh_prosp_plan + fit_hh_prosp_shortnotice + fit_hh_prosp_emergency
  find_evse =~ find_evse_prosp_nearby + find_evse_prosp_longtrip + find_evse_prosp_schedule
  observ =~ observ_evs + observ_charging + observ_stations
                 
  Intention =~ nextv_bev + nextv_phev + nextv_icev
                 
  # =======================================
  # Structural path
  # ======================================= 
  
  Intention ~ Symbolism + AoC + BEnv + Reactance + AntiIntel + 
              power + non_power + range + compatibility + find_evse + observ +
              trial + cost
              
  trial ~~ Symbolism + AoC + BEnv + Reactance + AntiIntel + 
              power + non_power + range + compatibility + find_evse + observ +
              + cost
              
  cost ~~ Symbolism + AoC + BEnv + Reactance + AntiIntel + 
              power + non_power + range + compatibility + find_evse + observ
